places.name: Inspiration Peak (Inspiration Point)
places.note: Reel calls it Inspiration Point in Joshua Tree. The summit above Keys View is Mount Inspiration / Inspiration Peak (5,560 ft). Trailhead is the Keys View parking lot, 33.9272, -116.18745.
places.recommendation: Ranked #5 for sunrise in the reel. Sweeping desert and mountain vistas at dawn, with orange skies over distant valleys.
places.source_title: 5 National Park Sunrises That Blew My Mind

places.name: Zabriskie Point
places.note: Badlands overlook off CA-190, southeast of Furnace Creek, facing Manly Beacon.
places.recommendation: Ranked #2 for sunrise in the reel. Eroded badlands with colorful striped formations and pink-lit distant mountains at first light.
places.source_title: 5 National Park Sunrises That Blew My Mind

additional_sources.recommendation: Recommends it as one of Zion's best views and possibly its best short hike: about 1 mile round trip, ~160 ft elevation gain, allow 1-2 hours, trailhead just east of the Zion-Mount Carmel Tunnel, with epic views over Pine Creek Canyon and Zion's cliffs. Incredible at sunrise or sunset. Short but with exposed drop-offs, so keep kids close.
additional_sources.source_reel_theme: Best short hike / best view in Zion
additional_sources.source_title: Canyon Overlook Trail — One of Zion's Best Views

places.name: Canyon Overlook
places.note: End of the 1-mile Canyon Overlook Trail, just east of the Zion-Mount Carmel Tunnel.
places.recommendation: Ranked #3 for sunrise in the reel. Massive red rock cliffs glow bright orange as the sun hits Zion Canyon.
places.source_title: 5 National Park Sunrises That Blew My Mind

places.name: Sunrise Point
places.note: Rim overlook at the north end of the Bryce Amphitheater, start of the Queens Garden Trail.
places.recommendation: Ranked #1 for sunrise in the reel, its top pick. Snow-dusted hoodoos bathed in intense golden-orange morning light.
places.source_title: 5 National Park Sunrises That Blew My Mind

places.name: Alum Cave Trail
places.note: Trailhead on Newfound Gap Road (US-441). Trail passes Arch Rock and its own Inspiration Point on the way to Alum Cave Bluffs and Mount Le Conte.
places.recommendation: Ranked #4 for sunrise in the reel. Layered forested ridges illuminated by soft sunrise light.
places.source_title: 5 National Park Sunrises That Blew My Mind
